cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Don't go yet. You came to return the key. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. I thought putting it down would take longer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I needed to see whether you'd sit down before giving it up.

mechanism: A manages a returned key as a routine handover but adjusts the conditions to keep a former resident welcome.
confusable: Possessiveness about property differs from returning to the key handover as a reason to stay and test the relationship.
comparison: The tea alternative bargains over minutes; this one renegotiates entry and welcome after a move.
seedUse: Key-return seed retains the object as an emotional excuse; S02 directs the handover then yields the key condition.
